terms.gloss: subject matter, a subject to talk or write about
evidence: Plin. Ep. 9.33.1: incidī in māteriam vēram
terms.comment: Lewis & Short: the matter, subject, topic, theme of any work of the mind; properly timber, building material.

terms.gloss: the subject or plot of a play, a story or a letter
a theme set for a speech or an essay
terms.comment: Greek θέμα; post-Augustan, in the schools of declamation (Seneca the Elder, Quintilian).

phrases.latin: incidī in māteriam vēram sed simillimam fictae
phrases.english: I’ve come across a subject that is true, but very like fiction
but to get back to Pliny

sources: Lewis & Short: materia · Lewis & Short: argumentum · Lewis & Short: thema
Morgan–Owens, Adumbratio: s.v. subject (topic).
John C. Traupman, Conversational Latin for Oral Proficiency, pp. 32, 387, checked against the searchable text of the book (9 November 2026).
Quotations from the Latinitas loci collections (loci-plinius, loci-phaedrus, loci-cicero-epistulae, loci-gellius), checked against the editions named there.
